title: Quaintly Smoky Mujadara
description: A hearty, aromatic Middle Eastern dish made with smoky lentils, onions, and rice. Perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: Lentils
ingredients.notes: Green or brown lentils work well in this recipe

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.notes: Long-grain rice is traditional in mujadara

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, rice, salt, black pepper, cumin, and smoked paprika. Stir to combine.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils and rice are tender.
Fluff the mujadara with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with a sprinkle of paprika, if desired.
